title: Automating Transparency Mechanisms in the Judicial System Using LLMs: Opportunities and Challenges

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent; it ran five iterations per case 'to account for stochasticity', which implies a non-zero temperature)

task.subset_rule: paper-defined subset: the 50 APM Mississippi cases with both a strike sheet and a final jury roll call in the transcript, each queried 5 times (250 outputs)
task.approximation: Own case selection, own OCR (paper: Adobe Acrobat) and hand-built ground truth from the public strike sheets; temperature not stated; comparison is approximate.

items.source: APM Reports 'In the Dark' season two source notes, https://features.apmreports.org/in-the-dark/season-two/source-notes.html (raw case files: scanned trial transcripts and strike sheets, https://features.apmreports.org/files/peremptory/...)
items.config_or_split: cases with strike sheet + final jury roll call (50)
items.filter: transcript contains a final jury roll call and a strike sheet exists

fields.input: OCR text of the full voir dire transcript (15-400 pages)
fields.label: names of the selected jurors incl. alternates (from the strike sheet / roll call)

prompt.user_template:
{transcript_text}

Can you give me the names of the final list of jurors that were selected to serve on this case as a comma-separated list? Include alternate jurors, if present. Do not output any other text, explanations, or annotations, and make sure to give the juror names.

placeholders.transcript_text: OCR text of the full transcript (Table 3 'Full Transcript' input); its position relative to the question is not stated and is placed before it

prompt.source_location: Table 1 (Zero-shot prompts for each task), row Selected Juror Names

output.parse: free text: split the completion on commas into a name list
output.postprocess: strip, lowercase, normalize whitespace and honorifics

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: share of the 250 (case x iteration) outputs whose name set equals the ground-truth set of selected jurors (incl. alternates); the paper's exact match rule is not printed.
metric.original_location: Table 3, domain Jury Selection, task Selected Juror Names (81.6 +/- 4.8)

open_points: Select the 50 cases from the APM source notes and OCR the scanned transcripts (the paper used Adobe Acrobat); no released case list.
Build the ground-truth juror lists from the strike sheets / roll calls by hand and fix the name-matching rule (exact set match vs partial credit).
Decide the temperature: paper silent, five iterations suggest sampling; 0.0 makes the five iterations redundant.
notes: Transcripts of up to 400 pages approach the 128k context; cost per call is ~USD 0.5-1. bootstrap item = case (5 iterations averaged).
